sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface labeling confirmed by SNAP PAGE imaging; protein half-life quantified by CHX-chase; agonist-stimulated functional responses measured in label-free DMR assays (cited as prior work in same system). No explicit comparison of tagged vs. untagged receptor signaling reported in this clip.
sites.rationale: All seven ledger lines (L1–L7) describe N-terminal tags on ADRA1A; the N-terminal domain (residues 1–25) is the sole extracellular terminus of this GPCR, so every N-terminal tag lands at insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1). No residue number is given in any clip, but exactly one extracellular terminus exists, making the position topology-derived. L2/L3 provide the strongest validation: SNAP-tag surface labeling in HEK293 cells confirms extracellular display. Convergent support comes from L4/L5 (FLAG after cleavable signal sequence, surface immunofluorescence confirmed) and L6/L7 (FLAG knock-in at endogenous locus). The 25-residue extracellular N-terminus is well clear of TM1 (≥25 residues from the prepend to TM1 boundary at residue 26), and the tag is upstream of the three N-linked glycosylation sites (N7, N13, N22) so it does not occlude them. SNAP-tag fused to the N-terminal domain of full-length α1A-AR/ADRA1A, transiently expressed in HEK293 cells; surface labeling performed with cell-impermeant SNAP substrate to confirm extracellular display; CHX-chase assay used to monitor receptor protein half-life.

literature_notes: All seven ledger lines converge on a single site: the extracellular N-terminus (insert_after_residue=0). L1 (PMC10282093) uses an exogenous HA signal peptide followed by FLAG on a truncated (1–370) but membrane-anchored construct; the FLAG is still at the mature N-terminus after SP cleavage, so it maps to the same junction. L4/L5 (PMC4424118) use a cleavable signal sequence + FLAG in TANGO-ADRA1A constructs with surface expression confirmed. L6/L7 (PMC10089924) place a FLAG knock-in upstream of the endogenous coding sequence (in vivo). No ledger line supports any internal loop (ECL1, ECL2, ECL3) insertion for ADRA1A. The 8×His C-terminal tag in L1 is placed at the intracellular C-terminus (after residue 370, which falls in the intracellular domain 329–466) and is recorded in other_positions. Glycosylation sites N7, N13, N22 in the N-terminal extracellular domain are downstream of the prepend position and are not disrupted by an N-terminal tag.

literature_other_positions.note: The truncated α1A-AR (1–370) construct carries an 8×His tag at its C-terminus; residue 370 (Q) falls within the intracellular C-terminal domain (topology: intracellular 329–466), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
